columns.name: Seller SKU ID
columns.help: Seller SKU ID is the identification number maintained by seller to keep track of SKUs. This will be mapped with Flipkart Serial Number.

columns.name: Group ID
columns.help: Group ID refers to a seller given intention to group products of the same design together on product page. For example, group ID will remain the same across size and color variants of a unique design.

columns.name: Parent Variant FSN
columns.help:
Parent Variant FSN refers to the Flipkart Serial Number of a product already created in your catalog, that you want to group your new products with.  

Please fill either Parent Variant FSN Parent Varinat FSN if you are adding new products to an existing group or  Group ID if you are creating a new group

columns.help: Time required to keep the product ready for dispatch. For Express, SLA value is in Hours and for the others, SLA is in Days

columns.name: Stock

columns.help: Date (dd/mm/yyyy) on which the product was manufactured or pre packed or imported. For products where day is not available, please put the manufacturing date as 1st of the month. Eg, 01/01/2018 for a product manufactured in Jan 2018.

columns.name: Shelf Life (MONTHS)
columns.help: Duration (in months) from the date of manufacturing beyond which the product shall not have the quality attributes normally expected by the consumers and the commodity should not be regarded as marketable

columns.name: Tax Code
columns.help: Flipkart’s tax code which decides the goods and services tax for the listing

columns.name: Minimum Order Quantity (MinOQ)
columns.help: Minimum number of units you want customers to buy

columns.name: Brand
columns.help: Brand refers to a type of product manufactured by a company under a particular name.

columns.name: Model Name
columns.help: Model Name is the identity of the product that helps in distinguishing it from other products. Possible values are Fresh Brew, Classic, etc.

columns.name: Tea Form
columns.help: Tea Form refers to the state in which the product comes in.

columns.name: Type
columns.help: Type refers to a category of tea having common characteristics.

columns.name: Ingredients
columns.help: Ingredients refers to the ingredients used in the making of a product. Possible values are Rama Tulsi, Krishna Tulsi, Green Tea, etc.

columns.name: Nutrient Content
columns.help: Nutrient Content refers to a label that gives you information about the nutritional value of a food. Possible values are Vitamin A: 78 mcg, Energy: 814 kcal, etc.

columns.name: Maximum Shelf Life
columns.help: Maximum Shelf Life refers to the time span until which the product is edible for consumption. Possible values 7, 10, etc.

columns.name: Maximum Shelf Life - Measuring Unit
columns.help: Maximum Shelf Life - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the maximum shelf life of the product. Units should be filled only in singular form.

columns.name: FSSAI Number
columns.help: FSSAI Number refers to the license number required to sell food products

columns.name: Usage Instructions
columns.help: Usage Instructions refers to all the instructions that are specified in order to make the product ready to eat. Possible values are Boil the noodles in hot water, Add cooked vegetables to the noodles, etc.

columns.name: Quantity
columns.help: Quantity refers to the volume or amount of product packaged in a given SKU. If there are two tea pack of 30 g each, fill the value as 60 g. Possible values are 100, 3.5, 20, etc.

columns.name: Quantity - Measuring Unit
columns.help: Quantity - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the external identifier. Units should be filled only in singular form.

columns.name: Container Type
columns.help: Container Type refers to the shape of a container that the substance comes in.

columns.name: Pack Of
columns.help: Pack of refers to the total number of main products that are included by the brand in the package. For example, if a pack contains 2 water bottles of different colors and capacity, then Pack of will be filled as 2.

columns.name: Main Image URL

columns.name: Regional Speciality
columns.help: Regional Speciality refers to products which are regional specific. Possible values are Assam, Darjeeling, etc.

columns.name: Organic
columns.help: Organic refers to whether or not the product is organic in nature. Possible value is Yes or No.

columns.name: Items Included
columns.help: Items Included gives the information of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double colon (::) separated.

columns.name: Video URL
columns.help: Video uploads aren't yet supported on Seller Hub. Please contact Seller Support to add videos to your product listings.

columns.name: Dietary Preference
columns.help: Dietary Preference refers to the different dietary characteristics present in the food based on preference.

columns.name: Gourmet
columns.help: Gourmet refers to whether or not the product is a gourmet. Possible value is Yes or No.

columns.name: Caloric Value
columns.help: Caloric Value refers to the total number of calories of the product. Possible values are 445, 110, etc.

columns.name: Caloric Value - Measuring Unit
columns.help: Caloric Value - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the caloric value of the product. Units should be filled only in singular form.

columns.name: No of Servings
columns.help: Number of Servings refers to the total quantity of food in the container suitable for or served to one person. Possible values are 30 cups, 50 cups, etc.

columns.name: Additives
columns.help: Additives refers to a substance added to something in small quantities to improve or preserve it. Possible values are Hot Water, Milk, etc.

columns.name: Manufactured By
columns.help: Manufactured By refers to the company which manufactures the product. Possible values are Karnataka Aromas, Mittal Group, etc.

columns.name: Model Number
columns.help: Model Number refers to the number assigned by the manufacturers to identify the different products that they offer. Possible values are TL44, 3453F, etc.

columns.name: Certification
columns.help: Certification refers to a document prepared by a notified body that describes and validates the authenticity and key characteristics of a product. Possible values are FDA, FCI, etc.

columns.name: Manufacturing Process
columns.help: Manufacturing Process refers to the important steps involved in making the product.

columns.name: Allergens Included
columns.help: Allergens Included refers to whether or not the product has allergens. Possible value is Yes or No.

columns.name: Fortified
columns.help: This refers to whether or not the product is fortified. Fortified is defined as the addition of micronutrients to the food. Possible value is Yes or No.

columns.name: Pack of
columns.help: Pack of refers to the total number of main products that are included by the brand in the package.

columns.name: Flavor
columns.help: Flavor refers to the different types of flavors tea comes in.

columns.name: Height (cm)
columns.help: Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot. Please ensure that the values entered are in Centimeters. Possible values are 11, 12, etc.

columns.name: Width (cm)
columns.help: Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of a product. Please ensure that the values entered are in Centimeters. Possible values are 13, 14, etc.

columns.name: Depth (cm)
columns.help: Depth refers to the distance from the front to the back of the product. Please ensure that the values entered are in Centimeters. Possible values are 12, 13, etc.

columns.name: Weight (kg)
columns.help: Weight refers to the weight of the product only, without packaging. Please ensure that the values entered are in Kilograms. Possible values are 15, 18, etc

columns.name: EAN/UPC
columns.help: EAN/UPC- refers to the unique 13 digit code given to each product which is universally recognizable.

columns.name: EAN/UPC - Measuring Unit
columns.help: EAN/UPC - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the external identifier. Units should be filled only in singular form. Possible values are EAN, UPC, etc.

columns.name: Description
columns.help: Please write few lines describing your product along with a list of products that are compatible with this product. Description is limited to 1000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.

columns.name: Key Features
columns.help: Key Features refers to the defining features of a product that can be highlighted on the website.

columns.name: Search Keywords
columns.example: Red Casual Tshirt for Women::Black Mens Tshirt::Printed Tshirt
columns.help: Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Flipkart website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.

columns.name: Key Spec 1
columns.help: Key Spec can list an important specification of the product, which will be helpful to the customer. This will show below the Title on the Website. The data entered here should be less than 22 characters (including spaces).

columns.name: Key Spec 4

columns.name: Set of
columns.help: Set of refers to the total number of boxes that are included by the brand in the package. If a product contains 2 boxes of 10 product each, please fill the attribute 'Set of' as 'Set of 2'.

columns.name: Other Features
columns.help: Other Features refers to any additional information on the features of the product that would be useful to a customer.

columns.name: Other Dimensions
columns.help: Other Dimensions refers to any additional information on the dimensions of the product that would be useful to a customer.
